circulars.applicability: All Banks (Chairman / Managing Director / Chief Executive Officer)
circulars.intent: RBI consolidates and updates all existing guidelines on note sorting machines, authentication and fitness sorting parameters, and BIS standards into a single Master Direction for ease of reference by banks.
circulars.action_required: Banks must ensure note sorting/authentication machines comply with the fitness sorting and authenticity parameters laid out, conduct quarterly calibration/testing with signed certificates, phase out discontinued NSM models by June 30, 2027, and henceforth procure only BIS-certified NSMs.

key_dates.label: Master Direction issuance / withdrawal of prior circulars
key_dates.quote: The previous circulars issued on the subject (Annexed) stand withdrawn from the date of issuance of this Master Direction

key_dates.label: Phase-out deadline for discontinued NSM models
key_dates.quote: NSM models deployed at banks which have been discontinued from production, shall be phased out on or before June 30, 2027

key_dates.label: BIS standard IS 18663:2024 publication date
key_dates.quote: published the standards for Note Sorting Machines (NSM) - ‘IS 18663: 2024’ in the ‘Gazette of India’ on March 19, 2024

circulars.impact_summary: All banks must align their note sorting and authentication machines with the consolidated fitness/authenticity parameters, conduct periodic testing, and transition to BIS-certified machines, phasing out discontinued models by June 30, 2027, or face penalties.

circulars.applicability: Authorised Dealers (AD) Category I banks and AD - Category II entities
circulars.intent: RBI is relaxing the earlier requirement that AD banks' internal guidelines for online/physical submission of Form A2 (for outward forex remittances) be approved only by the Board, now allowing approval by a delegated Board Committee or Management Committee as well.
circulars.action_required: Authorised Dealers shall frame appropriate internal guidelines with the approval of their Board or any Board Committee / Management Committee to which powers have been delegated by the Board, for facilitating outward forex remittances based on Form A2 submission; ADs must also notify constituents of the circular's contents. No specific deadline stated.
circulars.impact_summary: Authorised Dealer banks (Category I and II) are affected; they now have more flexibility in internal governance approval (Board or delegated Committee) for guidelines governing Form A2-based outward remittance processing, with all other prior instructions under Circular No. 12 remaining unchanged.
